double getProb(int x, int n) {
    double common = (double)x * (n - x) / (n * (n - 1));
    double termA = 1.5 * common * (n - x - 1) / (n - 2);
    double termB = 3.0 * common * (x - 1) / (n - 2);
    double termC = (double)x * (x - 1) * (x - 2) / (n * (n - 1) * (n - 2));

}

int main() {
    int n;
    double p;
    std::cin >> n >> p;
    int x = 0;

    }

}
